# nemau network subnet create

Create a subnet. An IPv4 subnet needs --cidr. An IPv6 subnet (--ip-version 6)
takes no range: the platform assigns a /64 from the region's routed prefix
and its first address as the gateway. The network must already have an IPv4
subnet, and instances created on it afterwards need a security group.

## Usage

```
nemau network subnet create <network-id> <name> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --cidr string      CIDR range, for example 10.0.1.0/24 (required for IPv4)
      --dns strings      DNS server (repeatable)
      --gateway string   gateway address (IPv4 only)
      --ip-version int   4, or 6 for a /64 assigned by the platform (default 4)
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
